== English errata comparison sources ==
The Limited card prints “but may move elsewhere,” “On Falcon” and “During battle,” and uses “destiny draw.” The November 1998 glossary removes the movement clause, broadens starships to anything he pilots, specifies piloting and once per battle, and refers to the destiny just drawn. Appendix A and the complete D-E1 image carry the glossary wording. The original and replacement retain the same lore, title, uniqueness, icons and numerical fields. The Reflections foil and Virtual Modern editions are separate printings. The previous PC Errata article title is retained as a direct redirect.
